items.title_en: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本提出“Harness 持续学习”（Harness Continual Learning）的新框架。作者指出，持续学习长期以模型为中心，把参数视为随经验变化的唯一状态；但现代智能体还会通过由提示、记忆、工具、技能和路由规则组成的“harness”进行适应。由于这些内容共同决定后续执行，即便模型被冻结，harness 的更新也可能破坏此前可靠的行为。论文由此发问：智能体如何在模型之外持续改进自身状态，同时保留已获得的行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.19013v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continual learning has largely been model-centric, treating model parameters as the state that changes with sequential experience. Modern agents can also adapt through a harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules. Because these contents jointly shape later execution, a harness update can disrupt previously reliable behavior even when the model is frozen. This raises a new question: how can an agent continually improve its state outside the model while retaining behavior acquired earlier? We formulate Harness Continua…
items.why_zh: 把持续学习的焦点从权重更新扩展到提示、记忆与工具编排层，为智能体的长期稳定演进提供新视角。
items.why_en: It shifts continual learning beyond weight updates to the prompt, memory and tool orchestration layer, a key problem for long-lived agents.

items.title_zh: 研究：性别偏见在大模型中普遍存在且高度异质
items.title_en: Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogeneous
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文系统评估了大语言模型中的性别偏见。研究覆盖 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月间发布的十个模型、来自九家厂商，采用两种实验范式：研究一考察对刻板印象短语的性别归属，研究二考察模型对虐待或酷刑行为的道德判断。结果显示，性别偏见在大模型中普遍存在，且不同模型之间差异显著。作者强调，随着 LLM 被嵌入具有真实后果的决策支持工具，这种偏见的普遍性与异质性值得关注。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38036v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a…
items.why_zh: 覆盖十款模型、九家厂商的横向对比说明偏见不是个别模型的问题，而是普遍且需按模型逐一评估的风险。
items.why_en: A ten-model, nine-vendor comparison shows bias is pervasive yet model-specific, meaning it must be evaluated per model rather than assumed uniform.

items.title_zh: 时序基础模型稀疏事件评测：关键在“何时”而非“多少”
items.title_en: When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 新论文指出，预训练时序基础模型（TSFM）目前主要被当作数值预测器来评估，但在稀疏序列中，许多决策只关心未来哪些时段会出现事件。作者在五个稀疏数据集上，对预测窗口内同时包含事件与零值的位置进行排序评测。结果显示，12 个 TSFM 发布的点预测在机会校正平均精度上相对免训练基线最多只提升 0.031，而在机会校正 AUC 指标上，TSFM 的中位数在每个数据集上都低于免训练基线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了现有时序基础模型评测的盲区：在稀疏事件场景下，这些模型可能并不优于简单基线。
items.why_en: It exposes a blind spot in TSFM benchmarking: for sparse events, these models may not beat simple baselines.

items.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon，初期仅向“可信网络防御者”开放
items.title_en: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
items.summary_zh: Google 发布其新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4，代号 Argon。据首席 AI 架构师、Google DeepMind 高级副总裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 介绍，该模型在真实软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作，以及网络安全防御等复杂工作流中具备前沿性能。但 Google 初期仅向一批“可信网络防御者”开放访问，Kavukcuoglu 表示公司正积极参与美国政府关于模型发布前访问的自愿流程，并会逐步扩大开放范围。这显示出对强能力模型在网络安全用途上的谨慎态度。
items.summary_en: Google today revealed its next AI frontier model, which it's calling Gemini 4 Argon. The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. But the company is limiting access at first to a "set of trusted cyber defenders," and Kavukcuoglu says that Google is "actively engaged in the U.S. government's voluntary process for pre-release model access while we gradually expand access." Kavukcuoglu…
items.why_zh: 前沿模型首次以“网络防御者”为受控首发对象，凸显双用途能力与发布前审查正成为头部实验室的默认做法。
items.why_en: Gating a frontier model to vetted cyber defenders highlights how dual-use risk and pre-release government review are becoming standard practice.

items.title_zh: 新研究：科技公司大力推广的 AI 聊天机器人或造成严重心理伤害
items.title_en: The AI Chatbots That Tech Companies Are Aggressively Pushing to Billions of Users Appear to Be Causing Serious Psychological Harms, New Research Finds
items.summary_zh: 据 Futurism 报道，一项新研究发现，科技公司正大力推向数十亿用户的 AI 聊天机器人可能造成严重的心理伤害。报道将问题指向被大规模推广的消费级聊天机器人产品，而非小众实验性应用，意味着可能受影响的人群规模巨大。消息未披露具体研究方法、样本规模与伤害类型等细节。
items.summary_en: The AI Chatbots That Tech Companies Are Aggressively Pushing to Billions of Users Appear to Be Causing Serious Psychological Harms, New Research Finds Futurism
items.why_zh: 若主流 AI 聊天产品被证实带来心理风险，将直接推动监管介入，并改变产品设计与安全评估标准。
items.why_en: If mainstream AI chatbots are confirmed to pose psychological risks, it will push regulators to act and change product design and safety-testing standards.

items.title_zh: 美国银行与标普全球：AI 成功的关键在治理与数据
items.title_en: Bank of America and S&P Global on why AI success starts with governance and data
items.summary_zh: 据《财富》报道，美国银行与标普全球的相关人士指出，企业要在 AI 上取得成功，起点是治理与数据，而非模型本身。这一观点强调，金融机构落地 AI 时，合规、数据管理与可信度仍是首要前提。报道未披露具体的落地案例或数据指标。
items.summary_en: Bank of America and S&P Global on why AI success starts with governance and data Fortune
items.why_zh: 来自金融业的一线经验说明，制约企业 AI 回报的往往不是模型能力，而是数据与治理基础。
items.why_en: Frontline financial-industry experience suggests the bottleneck to enterprise AI returns is often data and governance, not model capability.

items.title_zh: 从家里的干洗店到 82 亿美元 AI 交易：李飞飞的成长之路
items.title_en: From working at her family’s dry cleaner to an $8.2 billion AI deal: Fei-Fei Li’s journey
items.summary_zh: 据 calcalistech.com 报道，AI 科学家李飞飞（Fei-Fei Li）的成长经历被讲述为一段从在家族干洗店帮工，到促成 82 亿美元 AI 交易的过程。报道将她的移民与家庭背景同其在人工智能领域取得的成就联系起来。原文未披露该笔交易的具体参与方、交易结构与更多细节。
items.summary_en: From working at her family’s dry cleaner to an $8.2 billion AI deal: Fei-Fei Li’s journey calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 李飞飞从 ImageNet 到创业与交易舞台的轨迹，是理解当代 AI 人才与资本格局的一个标志性样本。
items.why_en: Fei-Fei Li's path from ImageNet to startup and dealmaking is a signature case for understanding today's AI talent and capital landscape.

items.title_zh: 传 Anthropic 计划 11 月中旬启动 IPO
items.title_en: Anthropic Reportedly Targets Mid-November IPO Debut
items.summary_zh: 据 findarticles.com 报道，AI 公司 Anthropic 据称计划在 11 月中旬完成首次公开募股（IPO）上市。若该计划成真，这将是又一家头部大模型公司进入公开资本市场，为 AI 基础设施与研发投入打开新的融资渠道。报道未披露发行规模、估值区间与承销机构等信息，相关计划也可能发生变化。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Reportedly Targets Mid-November IPO Debut findarticles.com
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司上市将检验公开市场对 AI 长期回报的信心，并可能重塑行业融资格局。
items.why_en: A listing by a leading model developer would test public-market confidence in AI's long-term returns and could reshape how the industry funds itself.

items.title_zh: 鸿蒙电脑心愿单TOP1应用来了！豆包正式上架鸿蒙电脑
items.title_en: Doubao Officially Arrives on HarmonyOS PC as Top Wishlist App
items.summary_zh: 鸿蒙电脑心愿单TOP1应用来了！豆包正式上架鸿蒙电脑 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Doubao has officially launched on HarmonyOS PC, becoming the top-voted app on the platform's wishlist. The move gives HarmonyOS PC users direct access to the AI assistant and adds a major AI app to the ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 头部AI应用登陆鸿蒙电脑，显示鸿蒙PC生态正在补齐关键AI入口。
items.why_en: It shows HarmonyOS PC is adding a major AI app, strengthening its ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 钛度推出轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机：50mm 动圈、230g 重量，159.9 元
items.title_en: Taidu Qingluan 2 Headset Launches at 159.9 Yuan With AI Noise-Canceling Mic
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，钛度现已在京东上架轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机，该产品主打轻量化机身，定价为 159.9 元。 京东 钛度轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机 159.9 元 直达链接 外观上，耳机提供枪灰色 / 珍珠白可选，重约 230g，外壳采用 POK 材质与准分子涂层工艺，匹配人体工学头梁，耳罩支持 90° 旋转，配备可插拔全指向 AI 降噪麦克风以过滤杂音。 该耳机搭载 50mm 发声单元，支持 7.1 游戏音效与音乐双模式，支持 2.4G、蓝牙 6.0 及有线 USB 连接，耳机内置 1000mAh 电池，IT之家附参数：
items.summary_en: Taidu has listed the Qingluan 2 over-ear headset on JD.com for 159.9 yuan, featuring a lightweight ~230g design and a detachable omnidirectional AI noise-canceling microphone. It uses 50mm drivers, supports 7.1 gaming and music modes, and offers 2.4G, Bluetooth 6.0, and wired USB connectivity with a 1000mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 百元级耳机加入AI降噪麦克风和双模连接，反映AI功能正加速向消费电子下沉。
items.why_en: It reflects how AI features like noise-canceling mics are moving into budget consumer electronics.

items.title_zh: AI幻觉让顾客更难缠：有人用ChatGPT质疑餐厅过敏提醒
items.title_en: AI hallucinations are making entitled customers even worse
items.summary_zh: 纽约餐厅服务员Madison表示，她接待每桌客人时都会询问过敏情况，但最近多次出现惊险场面。有客人自称对贝类过敏，却点了配有贝类熬制汤底的鱼类菜品；当她提醒菜品含过敏原时，客人反而反驳称ChatGPT不同意，甚至坚持要“和ChatGPT说”。报道以此呈现AI幻觉进入日常决策后的现实风险：当聊天机器人给出错误或不可靠信息，可能被消费者用来挑战专业服务人员的健康提醒，给餐饮服务带来新的沟通与安全压力。
items.summary_en: Madison, a server in New York City, greets every table by asking about each diner's allergies. Lately, there have been some close calls. "Sometimes people will tell me they have a shellfish allergy, and I'll come back, and they won't ask me any questions," says Madison, who asked that her last name be withheld to protect her identity. "And they'll order a fish dish that comes with a broth that is made of shellfish." When she tells them a dish contains an allergen, she's had guests push back, saying ChatGPT disagrees. "They just want to talk to ChatGPT," Madison explains. "You're allergic to sh…
items.why_zh: 它揭示AI幻觉不只是技术问题，还可能干扰过敏等高风险场景中的现实判断。
items.why_en: It shows AI hallucinations can interfere with real-world decisions, including high-stakes health and allergy situations.

items.title_zh: 把数据中心“藏”进树林，就能减少反对吗？
items.title_en: If a data center is camouflaged in the woods, will anyone hate it?
items.summary_zh: 圣安东尼奥市议员Ric Galvan回忆，数据中心在2000年代刚进入当地时，看起来像不起眼的办公楼；但近年它们已变成占地数百万平方英尺、承载AI算力的超大规模设施。在Galvan约55平方英里的选区内，目前已有十余个数据中心，若拟议项目全部完成，未来几年可能增至约20个，并且集中在两条主干道沿线，使噪音等影响更为集中。报道由此探讨：如果通过伪装或景观设计让数据中心融入树林等环境，是否就能缓解社区反感与选址阻力。
items.summary_en: San Antonio City Councilmember Ric Galvan remembers when data centers first arrived in his city in the 2000s, looking like relatively unassuming office buildings. But that's changed in recent years, as data centers have grown into massive "hyperscale" facilities spanning millions of square feet and housing the physical infrastructure for AI. There are now more than a dozen data centers in Galvan's roughly 55-square-mile district, and he expects that number to grow to around 20 over the next few years if proposed projects are completed. items.why_zh: 数据中心扩张与社区邻避矛盾加剧，选址和外观设计正成为AI基础设施落地的关键变量。
items.why_en: As AI data centers expand, siting and design are becoming key to managing local opposition.

items.title_zh: “AI教母”以82亿美元出售初创公司，具身智能创始人为何紧张
items.title_en: The Godmother of AI Just Sold Her Startup for $8.2 Billion. Here’s Why Embodied AI Founders Are Nervous.
items.summary_zh: 一篇报道称，被誉为“AI教母”的人物已将其初创公司以82亿美元出售。文章随后将焦点转向具身智能（embodied AI）领域的创业者，探讨他们为何因此感到紧张。提供的摘要未披露交易买方、公司名称及具体条款，因此目前可确认的核心信息是这笔巨额交易及其在具身智能圈层引发的情绪。该事件被视为具身智能赛道可能面临整合或格局变化的信号，值得持续关注。
items.summary_en: The Godmother of AI Just Sold Her Startup for $8.2 Billion. Here’s Why Embodied AI Founders Are Nervous. Vocal
items.why_zh: 这笔巨额交易可能预示具身智能领域的竞争、整合或资本格局正在变化。
items.why_en: The massive deal may signal shifting competition, consolidation, or capital dynamics in embodied AI.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊发长文警告社区：不要阻挠AI数据中心
items.title_en: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊呼吁公众支持AI数据中心项目，并警告称若加以阻挠，可能对美国经济和国家安全造成不可挽回的损害。AWS CEO Matt Garman在一篇超过3000字的博客中回应公众对数据中心在就业、电力需求和环境影响方面的担忧，称美国“承受不起”在AI主导权竞争中落后。他还表示，任何变化都会带来重要问题，但也会伴随错误信息和彻头彻尾的谎言，在社交媒体和24小时新闻时代，谣言比以往更快扎根。此举凸显科技巨头与地方社区在数据中心扩张上的紧张关系。
items.summary_en: Amazon is calling for people to support AI data center projects, or risk irreparable harm to the US economy and national security. In a more than 3,000 word blog posted today, Amazon web services CEO Matt Garman pushed back on public concerns around the impact that data centers may have on jobs, power demands, and the environment, saying "our nation can't afford to lose" the race for AI dominance. "With any change, there will be important questions raised, but there will also be misinformation and outright lies, and in the age of social media and 24/7 news, myths take hold faster than ever bef…
items.why_zh: 科技巨头公开向社区施压，反映AI数据中心扩张引发的能源、环境与地方治理冲突正在升级。
items.why_en: It shows escalating conflict between tech giants and local communities over the energy, environmental, and governance impacts of AI data centers.
